calendarNotes: Sarasota County Schools starts the 2026–27 school year for students on Monday, August 10, 2026 and ends the student year on Wednesday, May 26, 2027. The 196-day staff calendar begins August 3, and the last 196-day staff day is May 28. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 1 with a January 4 professional day before students return January 5, and Spring Break runs March 15–19 after the March 12 professional day. The calendar also lists mini breaks on March 26 and April 16 and notes that inclement weather makeup days may be used if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Sarasota County school start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day for Sarasota County Schools is Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Sarasota County in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. The calendar lists May 28 as the last day for 196-day staff.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Sarasota County Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Sarasota County Schools in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional day, so students do not attend school. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: What mini breaks are on the Sarasota 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists mini breaks on Friday, March 26, 2027 and Friday, April 16, 2027 for students and selected staff groups.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after Winter Break in Sarasota County?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return on Tuesday, January 5, 2027, after Winter Break and the January 4 professional day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Sarasota County use the same calendar for all schools?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar applies to districtwide dates such as holidays, breaks, and professional days. Individual schools may publish separate calendars for athletics, testing, performances, graduation, and campus events.

calendarFaqs.q: Which professional days and mini breaks fall outside the major breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are also off on October 12, 2026, and January 4, March 12, March 26, and April 16, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the Sarasota County Schools 2026–27 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the PDF download button on this page or the official Sarasota County Schools calendar source linked above. MySchoolDates also provides a one-time ICS calendar file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
content: The first student day moves from August 11 in 2025 to August 10 in 2026.
The last student day moves one day earlier, from May 27 in 2026 to May 26 in 2027.
Spring Break moves from March 16–20 in 2026 to March 15–19 in 2027.
Mini-break dates change from April 3 in 2025–26 to March 26 and April 16 in 2026–27.
